data-model-approved.reason: ⚠️ STILL NOT SATISFIED AFTER THE 2026-09-02 RE-EVALUATION, and this is the one criterion the spike did not clear. The agent layer persists five new shapes and only their LOCATIONS and SECRECY CLASSES are decided (DEC-0029). The shapes themselves are not: `.pi/kiln.json` (the stable project ID and non-secret capability choices), `runtime/consent.json`, `runtime/model-compatibility.json` with its exact invalidation key set, `runtime/setup-transaction.json`, and `runtime/kiln-session.json`. Each needs a declared schema, a version, an owner and a stated migration rule, and none has one. ⚠️ IT IS LEFT RED ON PURPOSE RATHER THAN ATTESTED THIN. Approving a data model that consists of five filenames would be the same act this whole cycle was opened to undo — a green gate over work that is not there. ⚠️ WHAT WOULD SATISFY IT: the five schemas authored and reviewed, with the compatibility record's key set enumerated exactly, because that set is what decides when a paid check is re-run. That is the first design task of Phase 2, ahead of the code that writes these files.
